subject: Permissions & Press: negotiating logo crediting and quiet-period in MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@brightlayer.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sarah.liu@brightlayer.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Permissions & Press - initial redline

Alex —

Thanks for the draft. Attached is BrightLayer's redline of the MSA (focused on Sections 7 and 9 re: Confidentiality and Publicity) and an annotated Order Form showing our requested limits on logo use and testimonial language. High-level items we care about: 

- Embargo / quiet period: we need a 30-day embargo after GA product launch before any external quote or co-branded announcement.
- Logo use: logo may be used only in case studies with prior approval of final creative; no automatic press kits.
- Reference rights: allow a short, pre-approved customer quote limited to 2 sentences; BrightLayer legal must approve final quote text and any customer logos.
- Audit evidence: we'll need a signed Order Form and a short SOC2 reference note attached to the contract before marketing activities.

Attached files: BrightLayer_MSA_redline.docx, OrderForm_v3_redline.pdf

Can you confirm Redwood's position on the quiet period and whether a short approval workflow (product marketing -> customer -> legal) is acceptable?

—Ethan
Legal, BrightLayer

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightlayer.com>, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Permissions & Press - initial redline

Ethan —

Thanks for the redlines and clear asks. Confirming receipt and looping in Kimberly (legal) and Ben (sales/marketing ops) to coordinate timelines. Quick answers up-front: 

- Quiet period: Redwood is comfortable with an embargo but would like to propose 21 days instead of 30 for commercial reasons; open to compromise if BrightLayer provides a short product launch window explanation.
- Logo & quote approval workflow: we can implement a 3-step approval (Redwood PM -> BrightLayer PR contact -> BrightLayer Legal) with a 48-hour SLA for approvals; if no reply, default to escalation to account exec for decision.
- Evidence: we can attach the signed Order Form and a SOC2 summary; let us know if BrightLayer needs an executed NDA addendum for marketing usage.

Kimberly, Ben — can you review Ethan's redline and the proposed approval SLA? If we can accept 30 days, we'll flag commercial concession to justify.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ethan.morales@brightlayer.com, sarah.liu@brightlayer.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Permissions & Press - initial redline

Alex / Ben —

Reviewed BrightLayer's redline. Legal position and suggested edits below (high level):

1) Embargo length: accept 30 days but add an exception where BrightLayer can request an earlier joint announcement with mutual written consent; Redwood may request early announcement where SR performance data is being publicly referenced (we'll provide a proposed carve-out).

2) Logo use: replace "may be used only in case studies" with a clarified "Permitted Uses" list (one-line bullets) and require Brand Guidelines file be the source of truth; Redwood can host a locked folder of approved assets once creative is signed off.

3) Customer quote: limit to 280 characters, require final pre-publication approval within 48 hours post-submission, and add a process for minor copy edits (non-substantive) by Redwood if requested by 1st-line PM; substantive edits require BrightLayer sign-off.

4) Evidence / order form: require signed Order Form (we'll accept DocuSign) before any marketing materials go live; for SOC2 we can provide a short attestation URL rather than full report.

I'll prepare a clean MSA markup that incorporates the compromise language and circulate to Ethan for a sign-off. Ben — will need you to confirm we can meet the 48-hour approval SLA operationally.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ethan.morales@brightlayer.com, sarah.liu@brightlayer.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Permissions & Press - initial redline

Quick operational note:

- Marketing can commit to a 48-hour turnaround on creative approval for BrightLayer provided they use the shared approval doc and include the final visual in the approval email. I'll pull the BrightLayer logo assets into our approved-asset drive (see attachment: BrightLayer_logo_guidelines.zip).
- If BrightLayer requests a 30-day embargo instead of 21, we should capture that as a commercial concession (50% credit on the first month overage) — propose I flag this in the commercial summary when we send the next Order Form revision.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Marketing
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Morales <ethan.morales@brightlayer.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sarah.liu@brightlayer.com, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 17:06:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Permissions & Press - initial redline

Alex / Kimberly / Ben —

Appreciate the quick turn. BrightLayer is prepared to accept the compromise language: 30-day embargo with the written mutual-consent carve-out, 280-char quote limit with 48-hour approval SLA, and the permitted-uses list for logo consumption. We will sign the Order Form once the clean MSA and the commercial concession are reflected in the Order Form PDF.

Attached: signed_OrderForm_BrightLayer.pdf (please countersign)

Next steps: Kimberly — please send the clean MSA markup and we'll route to our exec for a final sign-off. Ben — happy to take your commercial concession note (credit on first month overage) to procurement.

—Ethan
